snippet.title: Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes | Gameplay Overview Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Fall of the Twelve Colonies, Commander. 
Come with us, today, as we delve into your journey with Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes!

In today’s briefing we’ll take you through the basics of Fleet Management and Combat, which you’ll need to master to survive Cylon attacks and rejoin the Galactica.

Dive into each aspect, and get a handle on what’s coming, and let us know which areas you’d like to know more about! 
We’ll be back soon with a Deep Dive into the all-new Crisis System and Squadrons, alongside development updates.

Wishlist Battlestar Galactica: Scattered Hopes now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2535950/Battlestar_Galactica_Scattered_Hopes/

To keep up to date, follow, join or keep your comms frequency tuned in to:
- Discord: https://discord.com/invite/jgdQ7XY

- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/playbsg
